text:
nina-khan: Hi all, I'm Nina (CS) starting today. Quick blockers: HubSpot login keeps timing out, Aircall softphone not ringing, and I can't find the CS canned replies. Who should I ping?

lucas-ops: welcome Nina! @rachel-onboarding handles playbooks and canned replies; I can look at HubSpot/Aircall. What's your onboarding email?

nina-khan: nina.khan@redwood.ai

rachel-onboarding: added you to Notion: Customer Success > Onboarding > Quick Start. Canned replies live in Drive > CS > Templates. I'll drop the common ones into your DM.

lucas-ops: created access ticket ACC-7291 for HubSpot (role: CS Agent) and Aircall. Access-bot: created. ETA ~90 mins.

access-bot: Ticket ACC-7291 created and assigned to lucas-ops. Status: provisioning.

maria-cs-lead: FYI Nina, for first week aim: 1) HubSpot + sample contacts, 2) Aircall test call, 3) watch 4 training clips in Gong, 4) shadow 2 live calls. I'll add you to the calendar invites.

nina-khan: thanks! HubSpot finally lets me in but I can't import CSVs, permission denied.

lucas-ops: bumping ACC-7291 for CSV import perms. meanwhile, if you need to import a small list I can do it for you. Send the file to me or drop in Drive > CS > Imports.

rachel-onboarding: uploaded a short onboarding checklist to Notion and pinned the Playbook PDF. Also added a link to product one-pagers (Drive > Sales & CS > Collateral).

nina-khan: Aircall just rang! softphone looks good. Two quick ops questions: where do we log dispositions, and what's the preferred subject line for escalation emails?

maria-cs-lead: log dispositions in HubSpot activity (field: "Disposition"). Subject line for escalations: "[Escalation] <Customer> - <Quick reason>". Example: "[Escalation] Acme Corp - Billing Dispute".

lucas-ops: pro tip: if Gong recordings don't appear, check Aircall integration: Aircall > Settings > Integrations > Gong -> toggle on. I'll verify your number mapping.

nina-khan: got it. last one: are there any Slack channels I should join besides #customer-success?

rachel-onboarding: join #cs-queue, #cs-ops, and #cs-shadow. Also #product-updates for release notes. I'll invite you now.

nina-khan: perfect, thanks everyone! I'll post here if any of the tickets stall. :raised_hands:
